patch_description: The current program already reaches the reference ratio, so the new design focuses on squeezing the last digits out via a fundamentally better optimizer core: (1) SLSQP now receives analytic Jacobians for both the soft-min objective and all 91 pairwise diameter constraints (as a single vector-valued constraint), which makes the nonsmooth "max diameter" boundary tractable and convergence far more reliable; (2) an escalating-ftol perturbation cascade (1e-12 → 1e-14 with tiny Gaussian restarts, keep-the-better) attacks borderline plateaus exactly where score is won or lost; (3) a richer, cheaper seed zoo (antiprisms with varying twist/height, icosahedron+poles, two-shell, Fibonacci, random spheres) feeds a repulsion pre-stage that normalizes diameter and soft-maximizes all distances via inverse-power forces, so SLSQP starts near the constraint boundary. Everything is deterministic (seeded RNG) and returns a validated (14,3) array.
